unit01.note: No previous R programming is required.
unit01.setup: Use R/RStudio for runnable examples; this unit explains the setup.

unit02.setup: Use R for code examples; no data files are needed.

unit03.setup: No data files are needed. Create the objects on this page in the order shown.

unit04.setup: No data files are needed. Run each object definition before its indexing examples.

unit05.setup: Use your own project folder. Path strings illustrating another computer must be adapted.

unit06.setup: Keep input files in Data/ and practice outputs in Output/, relative to your project root.

unit07.setup: No data files are needed. Run setup and code blocks from the top of this page.

unit08.setup: No input files are needed. Build the example tables on this page before modifying them.

unit09.setup: Use R’s built-in data or the vectors supplied on this page. Run a base plot before adding layers.

unit99.note: These are optional extensions; choose only a topic you need.
unit99.setup: Each Spotlight states its own software and account requirements.

unit01-01_Intro.check: Distinguish the R language from the RStudio interface and choose the next setup step.

unit01-02_Installation.check: Open RStudio and check that an R command runs in its Console.
unit01-02_Installation.setup: Start with the installers linked below; install R before RStudio.

unit01-03_GUI.check: Locate the script editor, Console, Environment and Help/Plots tools.
unit01-03_GUI.setup: Open RStudio; no data files are needed.

unit01-04_first_steps.check: Create an object, run a calculation and distinguish commands from printed output.
unit01-04_first_steps.setup: Use an R script or the Console. Type only runnable code, not the output blocks.

unit01-05_selfhelp.check: Find help for one unfamiliar function and prepare a small reproducible question.

unit01-06_helpfiles.check: Find what a function accepts and returns in its help page.

unit01-07_summary.check: Recreate a calculation from a saved script and locate its function help.

unit01-08_DataCampEx.check: Predict arithmetic/assignment results, then compare the exercise feedback.
unit01-08_DataCampEx.setup: Use the embedded browser exercises. For local practice, run the corresponding commands in R.

unit02-01_Intro.check: Separate the meaning of data from its storage in R.

unit02-02_levels_of_measurement.check: Classify a variable’s measurement level and justify the choice.

unit02-03_qualitative.check: Distinguish unordered categories from meaningful category rankings.

unit02-04_quantitative.check: Distinguish counts from measurements and consider what their numbers mean.

unit02-05_types_of_data.check: Choose an R storage type for a quantity or identifier.

unit02-06_convert.check: Predict a conversion and inspect any changed or newly missing values.

unit02-07_summary.check: Convert a height column while preserving the meaning of its station codes.

unit02-08_DataCampEx.check: Inspect the class of an object and explain numerical versus text values.
unit02-08_DataCampEx.setup: Use the embedded browser exercises; no input files are needed.

unit03-01_Intro.check: Choose a structure for a table, a numeric rectangle or a mixed collection.

unit03-03_types_of_objects.check: Construct and inspect object types, dimensions and factor labels.

unit03-04_convert.check: Explain type changes when combining objects or converting factor labels.

unit03-05_Exercise.check: Choose and inspect a table, matrix/array and list without separating observations.

unit03-06_Solution.check: Compare your predictions and checks with one complete solution.
unit03-06_Solution.setup: The vector definitions are included here so the solution runs from its top.

unit03-07_Summary.check: Explain which structure you need and what a conversion changes.

unit04-01_Intro.check: Choose an index by position, name or condition.

unit04-02_index.check: Select or replace entries while keeping track of dimensions and return types.

unit04-03_subsetting.check: Select table rows using conditions and check what was retained.

unit04-04_summary.check: Filter known measurements and change a chosen value in a copy.

unit05-01_Intro.check: Distinguish objects in memory from files and project paths.

unit05-02_wenvironment.check: Explain where a relative path starts and how a project folder is organised.

unit05-03_packages.check: Distinguish installation, attachment and an explicit package::function call.
unit05-03_packages.setup: The install/attach screenshots are illustrations. The optional worked example needs reshape2 and internet for installation.

unit05-04_summary.check: Reopen a project, run a script and explain the session information.
unit05-04_summary.setup: Use your own RStudio project. Its file-free check does not require an input CSV.

unit06-01_Intro.check: Choose import/export checks before using a table for analysis.

unit06-02_csv.check: Identify separators, decimal marks and the header in a text table.

unit06-03_data_import.check: Inspect an import and compare CSV and RDS round trips.
unit06-03_data_import.setup: Save the supplied Quakes CSV as Data/quakes.csv. Create Output/ and start from the project root.

unit06-03b_destatis.check: Preserve identifiers, select appropriate geography and explain missing/rounded values.
unit06-03b_destatis.setup: Save the supplied Destatis CSV as Data/destatis-land-use-2024.csv. Run this page from the import step; do not reuse Quakes settings blindly.

unit06-04_batch_processing.check: Explain the validated one-file operation that the loop repeats.
unit06-04_batch_processing.setup: This is a preview. Skip and return after Unit 07 if loops are new; folder names in templates need your own small test inputs.

unit06-05_summary.check: Adapt export settings and verify the saved values and structure.
unit06-05_summary.setup: Use Data/quakes.csv from the import lesson. Practice writes new files under Output/.

unit07-01_Intro.check: Connect comparisons, decisions, repetition and returned results.

unit07-02_operators.check: Choose comparison and logical operators for the intended decision.

unit07-03_decisions_loops.check: Trace how a condition selects a branch or controls repetition.

unit07-04_if-then-else.check: Test smaller/equal/greater cases and explain which branch runs.

unit07-05_for-loops.check: Predict an iteration and collect one result per input value.

unit07-06_functions.check: Define a function’s inputs, default arguments and returned value.

unit07-07_apply.check: Choose a row/column/group application and inspect the result structure.

unit07-08_lapply.check: Compare list-returning application with a loop and explain local assignments.
unit07-08_lapply.setup: Create df at the top, then run sections in order. The repeated loop task is a comparison, not another required dataset.

unit07-09_while-loops.check: Predict how the condition changes and how to interrupt unintended repetition.

unit07-10_loop_exercise.check: Construct and compare stored vector/list results across all branches.
unit07-10_loop_exercise.setup: Save practice in an R script; no submission. Try the eight tasks before opening hints/solutions.

unit07-11_summary.check: Write a reusable decision and explain how a bounded loop exits.

unit08-01_Intro.check: Choose sorting, binding, key matching, grouping or reshaping for a task.

unit08-02_sorting.check: Keep rows intact and show what a secondary key does when values tie.

unit08-03_binding.check: Distinguish adding observations from matching attributes by identifiers.

unit08-04_merging.check: Specify keys and check duplicate matches and unmatched observations.

unit08-05_summary.check: Check text keys, join/group observations and explain their table layout.
unit08-05_summary.setup: Tables are supplied below. Only the final reshape check needs the installed reshape2 package.

unit08-06-string.check: Find, replace or split text and distinguish positions from logical matches.

unit08-07-aggregate.check: Distinguish a group summary from a changed layout and declare the observation unit.
unit08-07-aggregate.setup: The aggregation example uses built-in mtcars. The wide/long example additionally needs the installed reshape2 package.

unit09-01_Intro.check: Choose a plot for a category count, distribution, time series or relationship.

unit09-02_creating.check: Build a labelled graph and explain what each added layer contributes.
unit09-02_creating.setup: Create both car-count vectors first. Run layers in order on the same plot; no data download is needed.

unit09-03_histogram_density.check: Compare distribution views and explain bin/bandwidth sensitivity.

unit09-04_dotplot.check: Explain what one Cleveland dotchart point and row represent.

unit09-05_barplot.check: Distinguish counts from supplied summaries and label the category comparison.

unit09-06_boxplot.check: Interpret the median, hinges, whiskers and potential-outlier markers.

unit09-07_linechart.check: Sort a series meaningfully and retain original group identifiers.

unit09-08_piechart.check: Identify a single whole and judge whether its parts are easier to compare as bars.

unit09-09_scatterplot.check: Plot paired measurements and distinguish an observed association from causation.
unit09-09_scatterplot.setup: Use built-in mtcars. Make the points plot before optional fitted/smoothed overlays.

unit09-10_summary.check: Produce a suitable labelled chart and state one interpretation limit.

sl01_Intro.check: Choose one optional extension without treating every Spotlight as required.

sl02_github.check: For your chosen client, distinguish a local commit from a pushed commit.
sl02_github.setup: Optional: choose Desktop, command line or RStudio. Use a practice repository you control; hosting on GitHub requires your own account.

sl03_css.check: Render and inspect one intentional style change in an existing R Markdown workflow.
sl03_css.setup: Optional: use an Rmd that already renders to HTML. CSS styling does not require JavaScript.

sl04_opsi.check: Verify your personal package library after restarting on a suitable university PC.
sl04_opsi.setup: Optional and institution-specific: a Marburg Windows PC, university account and mapped H: drive are required.
